source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Extending H&K's proposal to denominal verb formation in Sakha
notes: However, if one takes a look at the paraphrases of (6) in (7), different case patterns are revealed. Whereas the accusative case marker can be dropped, the dative one cannot. Furthermore, the interpretation of unmarked accusative 'saddle' in (7a) is highly similar to the interpretation of incorporated 'saddle' in (6a): both are indefinite, non-specific and ambiguous between singular and plural. On the contrary, marked accusative 'saddle' is definite specific singular.
en: Ergis put the/a saddle on the horse.
